Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days to warn of a final payment, days a deposit is due, the highest cancellation rate you accept and your cash floor.
Check Advisors, Clients, Suppliers and Trips. They hold the people, clients, suppliers and trips that every other sheet looks up.
Log every supplier booking on Bookings: confirmation number, dates, price, commission rate, deposit and final payment. The net to supplier, balance owed and deadline checks fill in.
Record each client payment on Client Payments and each payment to a supplier on Supplier Payments, with who received the money.
Watch Payment Schedule, Final Payment Watch and Deposit Watch every week. Reminders, days left and the risk level are checked for you.
Keep Price Holds, Ticketing Deadlines and Supplier Cancellation Rules up to date so no hold, ticket or penalty date passes unseen.
Write each change on Booking Changes, each cancellation on Cancellations and each refund on Refunds. Penalties, refunds and the fee you keep are added up.
Check Supplier Statements against your own records each month and ask a supplier about any difference.
Open Cash Due Next 60 Days and Bookings by Month to see the cash held for suppliers and the payments coming in and out.
Use the 14 calculators for deposits, final payments, balances, refunds, penalties, changes, cash, supplier payments, instalments, late fees, split payments, ticketing and what-ifs.
Read the Bookings Dashboard and Charts every week: bookings, deposits, final payments, balances, cancellations, supplier payments and cash held.
Know what every trip earns and chase every unpaid commission

Trips with commission earned, unpaid and kept
One row per trip: client, type, dates, advisor, price, net price, expected commission and fee; commission share, commission received and unpaid, fees paid and what the business keeps fill in.

One row per supplier: category, commission rate, days until commission is paid and who collects; commission expected, received, unpaid, days to pay and how reliably they pay fill in by themselves.

One row per chase of a supplier: date, channel, contact, answer and promised date; the supplier, amount, days since, broken-promise check and answer-time check fill in by themselves.
Host agency statements with fee and difference check
One row per monthly host agency statement: commissions reported, host fee and amount paid to you; what you recorded, the difference, net share and match check fill in by themselves.
Host agency tiers by annual sales
Six tiers: the yearly sales from which each host rate applies; the Host Tier Planner reads this table to show your tier and the sales needed for the next one.
One row per commission a supplier paid short: claim date, status and amount recovered; the supplier, expected and received amounts, the difference, recovered share and result fill in by themselves.
Clawbacks and reversals with effect on payout
One row per commission a supplier took back: reason, amount and date; the supplier, share of the commission, host and advisor parts and the effect on the advisor payout fill in by themselves.
One row per rate change: supplier, date, new rate, rate before and source; the change, the supplier rate today and whether the row is still the live rate fill in by themselves.
Advisor payouts by month with year to date
One row per advisor per month: the payout rate and the date paid; the agency share from the commissions received, the payout amount, year to date and what is still owed fill in by themselves.
Team with advisor rate, payouts and unpaid commission
The owner advisor, four advisors and seven freelance specialists with advisor rate; commission received, payouts, payouts owed and unpaid commission on their trips fill in by themselves.
Service fees with days to pay and overdue check
One row per service fee: trip, kind, amount, invoiced and paid dates and status; days to pay, days open and the fee check fill in by themselves.
Commission forecast with probability and weighted amount
One row per commission still to come, plus the quoted trips: trip, supplier, expected date and amount; trip status, probability and the weighted amount fill in by themselves.
Supplier payment calendar with next expected payment
One row per supplier that pays commission: usual pay day, last payment and next expected payment; days since the last payment, unpaid commission and a late or due-soon check fill in.

One row per supplier bonus deal and year: sales target and bonus rate; sales so far from your bookings, progress, gap to the target, bonus earned and a gap check fill in by themselves.

Fourteen months: commission expected, received and unpaid, host share, advisor payouts and service fees; collection rate, total income and net earnings before overheads fill in by themselves.
